note: Motion at reduced resolution, 1440p, no pixels. Full motion costs 5.0 ms of the send (10.1 with, 5.1 without) and the composite needs it - serve.cpp uses the field for history reprojection and falls back to identity only when it is absent. --motion-small may keep temporal reuse at a fraction of the CPU cost. Compare the median against af's 21.8 ms (no motion) and z's 29.1 ms (full motion).
